entry.name: AI Engineering in Python
entry.note: A project-based learning path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Career changers who want to learn by building projects

covers: Core Python programming and developer tooling such as the command line, Git and virtual environments
Working with large language models through APIs, prompt engineering and tool use
Building and deploying AI applications with FastAPI, Docker and Docker Compose
Data analysis and visualization with pandas, NumPy and matplotlib
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning with scikit-learn
Embeddings, vector databases and semantic search
reading.format: An online learning path delivered on the Dataquest platform. Learners write code and get feedback directly in the browser, and work through several guided projects. The page describes the path as taking learners from zero to job-ready in 11 months.
reading.summary: AI Engineering in Python is a Dataquest learning path that starts with Python fundamentals and moves through LLM APIs, prompt engineering, data analysis, machine learning, deep learning, embeddings, vector databases and RAG systems. It ends with deploying AI applications using FastAPI and Docker. The page describes it as a career path from zero to job-ready in 11 months. Learners complete guided projects based on realistic business scenarios and finish with a portfolio of AI applications.
reading.audience: The page presents the path as a route from zero to job-ready for people who want the technical skills AI engineers need. It says the projects help learners build a portfolio and prepare for their next interview.
reading.prerequisites: None stated. The page says the path starts with Python fundamentals and takes learners from zero.
